title: PlayStation: another big PSN account hijacked 🔒
subject: playstation
description:
Do you have 2FA on your PSN account? 👇

On October 3, 2026, PlayStation content creator RealRadec said his PSN account was hijacked even with two-factor authentication: the attacker disabled 2FA and changed his email. It follows Colin Moriarty's similar case in May 2026.

Sources: Push Square (Oct 3, 2026), Notebookcheck, TweakTown

scenes.text: Another big PlayStation account was just hijacked.
On October 3, content creator RealRadec, with over 30,000 followers on X, said he lost his PSN account.
scenes.search: man looking at phone worried night

scenes.text: He says he wasn't phished, yet the attacker disabled his two-factor authentication and changed the account's email, locking him out.
It mirrors podcaster Colin Moriarty's case from May, when attackers reportedly fooled PlayStation support with just a PSN ID and a transaction ID.
